description: Workstream A: condensingApiConfigId API-configuration port. Clone the fully-wired enhancementApiConfigId round trip under a new name and thread the resolved handler into the three Task condensing call sites so summarization/condensing runs on a chosen reader model instead of the orchestrator's GLM. Default undefined/'' == use this.api (byte-identical to today). Implement per the APPROVED design at .agents/tasks/zoo-parallel-fabric/design.md — read it in full before coding; it specifies exact line targets and the single caching rule for the handler. Independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: Schema + ExtensionState: add `condensingApiConfigId: z.string().optional()` to globalSettingsSchema in packages/types/src/global-settings.ts immediately after enhancementApiConfigId (:271). Add `| 'condensingApiConfigId'` to the ExtensionState Pick union in packages/types/src/vscode-extension-host.ts beside enhancementApiConfigId (:320). Do NOT add it to the WebviewMessage.type union (batched save only, design §1/§2). Verify: pnpm --dir packages/types exec tsc --noEmit.

ClineProvider round trip (src/core/webview/ClineProvider.ts): add condensingApiConfigId to the getStateToPostToWebview() destructuring (:2649), to the object it returns (:2824, shorthand), and to the object returned by getState() as `condensingApiConfigId: stateValues.condensingApiConfigId` (:3061). Bare pass-through, no ?? '' default (keep undefined canonical).

Persistence test (no handler case needed — generic updateSettings path, design §2): add a test to src/core/webview/__tests__/webviewMessageHandler.spec.ts sending updateSettings with condensingApiConfigId and asserting contextProxy.setValue('condensingApiConfigId', <value>) + postStateToWebview ran.

Task.getCondensingApiHandler() (src/core/task/Task.ts) per design §4: add private async helper + two cache fields (condensingApiHandler?: ApiHandler, condensingApiHandlerConfigId?: string). Resolve from provider.getState() (condensingApiConfigId + listApiConfigMeta): unset/empty/dead-provider/not-in-meta/no-apiProvider/thrown -> return live this.api (never cache it); valid -> buildApiHandler(providerSettings) cached keyed by config id. Single caching rule: if currentId === this.condensingApiHandlerConfigId reuse prior decision, else re-resolve. Guard the missing-id case against getProfile's throw (ProviderSettingsManager.ts:480) via the listApiConfigMeta membership check; wrap getProfile/buildApiHandler in a defensive try/catch that provider.log(...)s per-call and falls back to this.api. buildApiHandler already imported (Task.ts:64); providerSettingsManager is public readonly on ClineProvider (:354) via this.providerRef.deref().

Unit test for getCondensingApiHandler() in src/core/task/__tests__ covering design §7 (a)-(f): unset->this.api (identity); id absent from meta->this.api and getProfile NOT called; valid->built handler (buildApiHandler called with resolved settings, result !== this.api); no apiProvider->this.api; getProfile throws->this.api + logged; mid-task change (id A caches, id B rebuilds, unset->this.api). Mock provider, getState, providerSettingsManager.getProfile, buildApiHandler.

Thread into the three condensing call sites in src/core/task/Task.ts, resolving per-invocation: condenseContext()->summarizeConversation (~2011), handleContextWindowExceededError()->manageContext (~4575), attemptApiRequest()->manageContext (~4834). At each: `const condensingApiHandler = await this.getCondensingApiHandler()` then pass `apiHandler: condensingApiHandler` replacing `apiHandler: this.api`. No signature change to manageContext/summarizeConversation. Add a three-site threading test (handler from getCondensingApiHandler() passed as apiHandler at each site; equals this.api when unset, built handler when set).

SettingsView UI (design §6): in webview-ui/src/context/ExtensionStateContext.tsx add condensingApiConfigId?: string to the context type + default condensingApiConfigId: '' (mirror enhancementApiConfigId :110,:228). In ContextManagementSettings.tsx add 'condensingApiConfigId' to the SetCachedStateField key union (:48-51), add the field as a prop, render a Select/SelectItem picker (pattern from PromptsSettings.tsx:166-190) listing listApiConfigMeta with a '-' = 'use current configuration' option mapping to ''; annotate the .map callback param as { id: string; name?: string } to avoid implicit-any. Bind to destructured cachedState; onValueChange -> setCachedStateField('condensingApiConfigId', value === '-' ? '' : value). MUST NOT postMessage on change or read live useExtensionState(). In SettingsView.tsx pass the field/prop down and add `condensingApiConfigId: condensingApiConfigId ?? ''` to the updatedSettings object in handleSubmit() (:390 block).

Webview tests (design §7 case 6): (a) set — ContextManagementSettings.spec.tsx select a profile -> setCachedStateField('condensingApiConfigId', <id>); SettingsView.spec.tsx drive + Save -> updateSettings payload condensingApiConfigId === <id>. (b) unset — '-' maps to '', Save carries condensingApiConfigId: ''. (c) cachedState binding/revert-on-discard — mirror SettingsView.unsaved-changes.spec.tsx:736-762: live '', select a profile, assert NO postMessage on change, Done -> discard, assert picker reverts to live '' and no updateSettings carried the discarded id.

Import/export round-trip assertion (design §7 case 5): condensingApiConfigId is a plain string in globalSettingsSchema, not in globalSettingsExportSchema.omit (ContextProxy.ts:35), so it round-trips via importSettingsFromPath setValues (importExport.ts:231). Add a test asserting export includes it and import restores it (not stripped). No production change.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm --dir packages/types exec tsc --noEmit and pnpm --dir src exec tsc --noEmit and pnpm --dir webview-ui exec tsc --noEmit all pass.
With condensingApiConfigId unset, all three condensing sites pass this.api (byte-identical to today) — proven by the threading test.
With a valid condensingApiConfigId, getCondensingApiHandler() returns a handler built from the chosen profile and the three sites use it; mid-task config change rebuilds the handler.

The SettingsView condensing picker binds to cachedState (no postMessage on change) and is included in the handleSubmit updateSettings payload as condensingApiConfigId; discard reverts to the live value.
The setting round-trips through ClineProvider.getState/getStateToPostToWebview and through import/export.
src/eslint-suppressions.json counts for any edited src/ file did not increase; no .changeset created; no CHANGELOG edits.
verification: pnpm --dir src exec vitest run src/core/condense src/core/context-management src/core/task/__tests__
For each edited src/ file: pnpm --dir src exec eslint --prune-suppressions --max-warnings=0 <relative-file> (count not increased)
findings: Implemented per the approved Workstream A design. Files changed: packages/types/src/global-settings.ts (condensingApiConfigId after enhancementApiConfigId), packages/types/src/vscode-extension-host.ts (ExtensionState Pick union, NOT WebviewMessage.type), src/core/webview/ClineProvider.ts (all 3 enhancementApiConfigId sites: getStateToPostToWebview destructure + returned object, getState returned object as bare stateValues.condensingApiConfigId pass-through, no ?? '' default), src/core/task/Task.ts (private getCondensingApiHandler() + cache fields condensingApiHandler/condensingApiHandlerConfigId; threaded into all 3 condensing sites: condenseContext->summarizeConversation, handleContextWindowExceededError->manageContext, attemptApiRequest->manageContext, each resolving per-invocation via `const condensingApiHandler = await this.getCondensingApiHandler()`). webview: ExtensionStateContext.tsx (context type + '' default), ContextManagementSettings.tsx (cachedState-bound Select picker with '-'=='' use-current option, .map callback typed {id:string;name?:string}; extended SetCachedStateField union + prop), SettingsView.tsx (prop passthrough + condensingApiConfigId: condensingApiConfigId ?? Reused existing i18n keys settings:contextManagement.condensingApiConfiguration.{label,description,useCurrentConfig}. Tests added: webviewMessageHandler.spec.ts (generic persist set + clear), ClineProvider.spec.ts (round-trip set + unset-undefined), importExport.spec.ts (import round-trip not stripped by omit list), Task.condensing-handler.spec.ts (design §7 a-f + dead provider ref), Task.condensing-threading.spec.ts (condenseContext + handleContextWindowExceededError pass resolved handler/this.api as apiHandler for set+unset), ContextManagementSettings.spec.tsx (picker renders, setCachedStateField on select, '-'->''), SettingsView.spec.tsx (Save payload set + unset ''), SettingsView.unsaved-changes.spec.tsx (cachedState revert-on-discard, no postMessage on change). NOTE for later steps: the shared mock Select in ContextManagementSettings.spec.tsx now derives its change-trigger testid as `${select data-testid}-change` (threshold Select -> 'threshold-profile-select-change'; condensing Select has no data-testid so falls back to 'threshold-profile-change'); existing combobox-count assertions were bumped from 1 to 2 because the condensing picker renders unconditionally. All verification green: tsc (types/src/webview-ui), vitest (webviewMessageHandler, ClineProvider, condense, context-management, task/__tests__, importExport, ContextManagementSettings, SettingsView, SettingsView.unsaved-changes), and the eslint --prune-suppressions --max-warnings=0 per-file gate (suppression counts unchanged; new test files have 0 suppressions, fixed `as any`/`d:any` in new code rather than suppressing).
